_meta.disclaimer: All factors below are ROUGH ESTIMATES compiled from public emission-factor tables (e.g. UK DEFRA, US EPA, Environment and Climate Change Canada). Real emissions vary with vehicle efficiency, driving style, regional grid mix, heating systems and food supply chains. CarbonCut is a personal-awareness tool, not a carbon-accounting instrument.

beef.note: Beef-based meal; ruminant methane dominates. Estimate.

fish.note: Average fish/seafood meal; varies widely by species. Estimate.

green_tariff.note: Certified renewable electricity tariff; residual lifecycle emissions. Estimate.

grid.note: Mixed-grid electricity; varies hugely by region (Ontario's grid is far cleaner). Estimate.

solar.note: Rooftop solar at point of use. Estimate.

bus.note: City bus, per passenger-km at average occupancy. Estimate.

car_diesel.note: Average diesel car, single occupancy. Estimate.

car_electric.note: EV charged on an average grid mix; near-zero on clean grids. Estimate.

car_gasoline.note: Average gasoline car, single occupancy. Estimate.

flight_long.note: Long-haul flight, per passenger-km incl. radiative forcing uplift. Estimate.

flight_short.note: Short-haul flight (<1500 km), per passenger-km incl. radiative forcing uplift. Estimate.

rideshare.note: Same as a gasoline car; carpooling splits it per passenger in reality. Estimate.
